projects.title: Real-Time Multi ISP (Image Signal Processing) Systems for Automotive Vehicles
projects.description:
- Designed Camera Frameworks, Linux kernel device driver and Image Signal Processing with multi-threading and parallel Image and Meta buffer structure for processing more than 10 multi-cameras in IVI, ADAS and autonomous driving system
- C, C++,Image Signal Processing, Camera Sensor, Linux Kernel, Android Automotive OS

projects.title: A* Pathfinding with NavMesh Generation for the robot
projects.description:
- Optimizing navigation and pathfinding in an environment requires a strategic approach that leverages both - the A* algorithm and NavMesh generation. The A* algorithm is essential for finding the shortest path between two points, while the NavMesh aids in creating a discretized representation of the navigable space. Together, these tools provide a comprehensive solution for efficient pathfinding and navigation.
-C#, Unity3D, A* Search, Greedy Search, NavMesh Generation
